close_dirty_confirm: File has unsaved changes. Close anyway?
projects_hint: Drop an .xml file or a mod project folder here
hist_hint: Change journal of the file. Clicking an entry moves the file to the state right after that change; undone entries (dimmed, at the top) are redone forward.
hist_clear_confirm: Delete all history records of this file?
hist_restored: File rolled back to the selected state
recents_clear_confirm: Remove all recent files and projects from the list?
cmp_merge_confirm: Copy everything new from the right table into the left one? Right wins on conflicts.
up_sub: Unpack the game archives to compare them with your mod and edit them
set_unpacked_hint: Used by the «Game» tab in the project tree. After a successful unpack the path is saved automatically.
hk_conflict: This shortcut is already in use
cmp_no_base_row: No paired row in the base
cmp_no_base_col: Column is missing in the base
up_saved_unpacked: Unpacked game folder saved — «Game» tab is now available
cmp_sub: Compare mod files or folders with the base game and transfer the differences
cm_sub: Create your own mod or extend an existing one with files from the project tree
up_hint: All game paks extract into basis\: basis.pak first, then patches by number — each next one overwrites the files. Legion -> dlc\legion\basis, Resistance -> dlc\resistance\basis, Evolution -> dlc\evolution\basis.
cmp_hint: Pick a file or folder on the left (base) and on the right (source), then press Compare
cm_icon_hint: A 16:9 image — it will be saved as basis/THUMBNAIL.dds inside the mod.
cm_need_dir: Set the installed game folder first
cm_err_exists: A mod with this name already exists
cm_drop_hint: Drag files from the tree on the left (Ctrl — multiple files)
cm_rel_none: Outside the project — will go to basis/scripts/
tree_not_editable: This format cannot be opened in the editor yet
fix_file_msg: Recompute ss:ExpandedRowCount/ColumnCount from the actual content and write the file. This fixes Excel refusing to open it (WPS behaviour unchanged). Untouched bytes stay as-is.
fix_file_nothing: Nothing to fix: counters already match the content
recover_msg: This is not valid XML (truncated structure). Open it in recovery mode? Damaged parts will be lost and autosave will be disabled - only explicit save will write the file.
recovered_banner: File opened in recovery mode (it was damaged). Autosave is off: save explicitly.
swt_sub: Mission scripts (.swt): triggers, conditions and actions
swt_pick: Pick a trigger on the left
swt_no_changes: No changes — file is up to date
upr_need_project: Open a mod project — the map looks for shop_presets.xml in dlc\Resistance
upr_need_unpacked: Set the unpacked game folder in settings — the map will take shop_presets.xml from there
upr_src_dirty: Unsaved changes to the current shop_presets.xml will be lost. Continue?
upr_pick: Pick a sector on the map
up_foot: Unpacking the base game and DLC
set_browser_to_tray: Minimize to tray when opening in browser
cmp_rep_diff: Replace is only available in file preview mode
set_auto_hide_tree: Hide tree when a file opens
swt_trig_name_tt: Trigger name (arbitrary, local to the file)
swt_flag_active_tt: Trigger enabled: participates in the mission
swt_analyze_tt: Re-analyze: rebuild file values and project dictionaries (units, vehicles, upgrades) for suggestions
set_mod_path_hint: Path to your created mod (for mod developers). Filled automatically when a mod is created; used by the "Copy to mod" command.
set_project_path_hint: Root of the current project. Used by the tree by default and auto-loaded on startup.
ctx_no_mod_path: Set the mod path in Settings (Paths → "Main mod path")
upr_colors_hint: Zone color on the Uprising map. "Map default" — color by zone faction.
upr_bind_need: Assign difficulty first: units will inherit their zone difficulty. Bind now?
upr_cfg_confirm: Apply configuration to the current map?
upr_reset_msg: The map will return to its original state: shop_presets.xml will be restored from a clean copy, the balance config deleted, zone difficulties and colors reset.
upr_reset_pristine: No changes were made — clean copy created
cmp_merge_t: Move all new from right to left

hist_reset_all: Roll everything back to the start
hist_reset_all_confirm: All journaled changes will be undone.
hist_stock_confirm: The files will be overwritten with originals from the main mod; the change journal will be cleared.
hist_stock_no: No stock file in the main mod:
hist_stock_nomod: Main mod path is not set in settings
hist_stock_outside: File is outside the open project - stock rollback unavailable
upr_need_mod: Set the main mod folder in settings — the map will take shop_presets.xml from there
hist_stock_skip: Files outside the project skipped (stock is only available for project files)
upr_rnd_h_cats: Which unit types get shuffled. A disabled category stays in place.
upr_rnd_h_balance: Chaos (k) is shuffle strength: 0 changes almost nothing, 2 scatters everything. Weight ×N decides which types get the stronger sectors.
upr_rnd_h_diff: Sector difficulty is read from the map. “Bind” sets it from garrison costs.
upr_rnd_h_faction: Whether units may move into other factions’ sectors.
upr_rnd_h_geo: Where units may not go and how many heads one sector holds (0 — unlimited).
upr_bulk_diff_hint: Set difficulty for all selected (4 or 3-5, empty - inherit zone)
set_guard_unpacked_hint: When saving a file, offer to save into your project or mod.
upd_hint: Auto-check runs at startup and every 30 minutes (if enabled). A downloaded update installs itself with a restart.
guard_title: Cannot save changes into a protected folder
guard_hint: If the file does not exist, it will be copied into the folder.
guard_to_project: Save the changed file into project
guard_to_mod: Save the changed file into mod
guard_no_dest: Set the project or mod path in settings
upr_sec_swap_t: Swap sector {n}: contents of sector No.
upr_sec_clear_m: All sector contents will be removed.
